sum: FG Communities Holdings Inc. operates as a real estate focused operating company and merchant bank. It engages in the acquisition, ownership, and operation of land-lease affordable housing communities. The company also offers merchant banking services, including advisory services, capital formation, and investments in other businesses. The company was formerly known as FG Nexus Inc. and changed its name to FG Communities Holdings Inc. in September 2026. FG Communities Holdings Inc. is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
ceo: Mr. Daniel Kyle Cerminara C.F.A., CFA (Co-Founder, Chairman of the Board & CEO)
